notes.title: Once Again - Official Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
If the past couple of years have taught us anything, it’s that everything can change in the blink of an eye.
Beloved faces we used to see every day, now distant memories. Long-awaited vacations, now but a folder of unused tickets.
 
“Once Again” our debut interactive story game - is a tribute to all the good times we’ve had with our loved ones, and a prayer for the chance to say every unsaid goodbye.
 
So is a goodbye an ending, or a promise for a reunion?
This summer, let’s find the answer across time and space.

We’re so proud to have Taiwanese singer-songwriter Cheer Chen as our narrator and voice actor  for Once Again’s trailers and ending! Beloved for her ability to evoke heartfelt feelings of parting ways, deep love and reuniting with a loved one just through her voice and guitar, let Cheer Chen tell you the story of Once Again with her moving voice this summer.
 
✨Voice Actor✨Cheer Chen
✨Music Composer✨WeiFan Chang
